kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمايل (form VI)
# نَتَمَايَلُ (natamāyalu) /na.ta.maː.ja.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# نَتَمَايَلَ (natamāyala) /na.ta.maː.ja.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# نَتَمَايَلْ (natamāyal) /na.ta.maː.jal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
